entities.summary: Fanny Friedman MBE is a doctor and political figure in Eswatini. Friedman was also the first woman in her country's history to hold the post of minister and first female Senator in her Country from 1987 to 1993. Fanny Friedman was a physicians & medical pioneers from Eswatini (b. 1926-06-21, Eswatini). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
